description: This file defines the 'Loop' class, which implements a loop operation for a mini-language within the OFBiz framework. It handles execution of a loop based on a count expression, with support for break and continue control flow, and manages sub-operations within the loop.

classes.name: Loop
classes.description: Implements a loop operation for the mini-language, executing sub-operations a specified number of times with support for break and continue.

classes.name: Loop.LoopFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating Loop instances from XML elements.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the loop based on the count expression, handling break and continue exceptions, and executing sub-operations.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Loop object.

methods.name: createMethodOperation
methods.description: Factory method to create a Loop instance from an XML element.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the operation, 'loop'.
